scores.evidence: Each of the 3 can-do objectives has 2 or more graded questions, and each set includes an apply-level item or higher (o1: q4, e1, e2; o2: q2, q3, e3; o3: q5, e6). But o1 lists 「CLAUDE.md・.claude/rules/・CLAUDE.local.md・権限ルール」, while its two exam items test a hook (e2, answer 「フックで自動的に実行させる」) and AGENTS.md loading (e1). Neither of those is among the places o1 names.

hook-predict changed only in its explanation (「Claudeが読むコンテキスト（context）です」); q0 is still an ungraded prediction tied to o3 after the concrete problem in hook-b1. hook-b1 still promises 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう」 while the prediction covers only blocking `.env`.

Prerequisites 第1回–第5回 are recalled where needed (「第1回と第5回で見たとおり」 in s1-lead, 「第2回で書いた…」 in hook-predict and s4-defs). The changed glossary AGENTS.md entry now gives the same condition as s3-defs (「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上にCLAUDE.mdもCLAUDE.local.mdもないときに読まれます。`.claude/CLAUDE.md` も、CLAUDE.mdに数えます。」).

measure.mjs: 「prose 2400 (budget 1,200–2,400) · questions 9 · est 19.0 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 19)」, so prose sits exactly at the cap and estMinutes matches; lint --strict 0 warnings. s3-lead was cut to 「長くなったファイルは分けて整理できます。」, but s3 still carries imports, rules, AGENTS.md, a code block, a diagram and a callout in one segment.

s5-steps is a complete worked example before practice: 6 subgoal-labelled steps (「① コードからわかる行を消す」…「⑥ 自分だけの好みをローカルへ移す」), each with a reason in md and a result in expect (「チームのCLAUDE.mdは2行になります」). No faded example sits between it and the independent 18-line practice.

s1–s4 each end with an inline check that gives feedback on every wrong option. q2 is now a repair item, and q4 asks where a new 10-line rule set belongs. Two items are still partly answerable by recognition: q2's answer is the only option that repeats s1-concat's phrase 「矛盾する2行」, and q5's answer 「判断の材料として読まれ、強制はされない」 restates s4-lead 「参考に判断しますが、必ず守るという保証はありません」.

Every misconception in the brief appears as a distractor, with feedback of 2 sentences or fewer: override vs concatenation (q2 b, e1 a), `@` reducing context (q4 c, e3 a), longer is better or the 200-line limit as a guarantee (q5 b, e6 b), auto mode (e6 d). The deny overclaim is gone. But the 「IMPORTANT」 option is the wrong answer in five items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e3 c, e6 a), so learners can eliminate it by pattern. The 「前の会話を覚えている」 misconception appears only once (q0 c).

s1-table and s4-table are now 2-column comparisons that keep all the information (「プロジェクト：チーム（Gitで共有）」, 「フック（第8回）」). The reworked s3-diagram (6 nodes, caption states the takeaway) now draws `A["CLAUDE.md
インポート先"] --> C["paths: なしの
ルール"] --> X[コンテキスト]`, a chain that shows CLAUDE.md feeding into the rules, which the text never says.

The authentic 18-line task, 3-level hint ladder, 7-item checklist (now in です・ます: 「…確かめました」) and model answer remain. The split lines in practice-setup and practice-answer keep the 18-line file and the `sed -n '12,18p'` before the overwrite, and practice-answer's highlight moved from 4–8 to 5–9, which matches the four kept lines and the HTML comment.

summary-points follows the exam; summary-next keeps the reflection question (「ここ1週間で、Claudeに2回以上した同じ説明や直しはありますか」) and now names the next lesson by its real title (「第7回｜手順はスキルに、調べものはサブエージェントに」, the cc-07 draft title). summary-cards has 7 cards.

s3-defs AGENTS.md (「既定では、作業フォルダーとその上にCLAUDE.mdもCLAUDE.local.mdもないとき、代わりに読まれます。`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` や組織のCLAUDE.mdがあっても読まれます。」) and the glossary now match the audit quote 「Count…: a CLAUDE.md, .claude/CLAUDE.md, or CLAUDE.local.md in your working directory or any directory above it」. The table rewrites keep the same facts (`/etc/claude-code/` のCLAUDE.md, 第2回/第7回/第8回 targets).

The changed text keeps です・ます and a warm tone: the checklist labels now read as statements (「…確かめられない行がありません」, 「…確かめました」), the prompt hint says 「18行分を書きます」, and summary-next invites rather than pushes (「置き場所を考えてみましょう」). Lint --strict finds no banned phrase or long sentence; wording is left to ja-editor.

The jp locale is complete, s3-diagram has caption and alt, and the link text says where it goes (「公式ドキュメント（日本語）」). But the changed alt describes 「（と自動メモリの先頭）」, which the reworked diagram no longer shows.

mustFix.issue:
Regression from the s3-diagram rework. The new code chains `S --> A["CLAUDE.md
インポート先"]`, `A --> C["paths: なしの
ルール"]`, `C --> X[コンテキスト]`, and A has no edge of its own to X. The rendered diagram shows CLAUDE.md and its imports passing through the unscoped rules into the context, as if rules were loaded by or through CLAUDE.md. s3-defs says rules are separate files read at startup, and import vs rules is the very distinction this segment teaches. The changed alt also describes 「（と自動メモリの先頭）」, which the diagram no longer shows, so screen-reader users get different content than sighted ones.

niceToHave: s3-defs and glossary AGENTS.md: 「ほかのAIコーディングツールと共有する指示のファイル（v2.1.277以降）」 attaches the version to the file, but the audit quote says 「Reading AGENTS.md directly requires Claude Code v2.1.277 or later」. Consider 「ほかのAIコーディングツールと共有する指示のファイル。Claude Codeはv2.1.277以降で読みます。」 (keep each sentence ≤ 60 chars).

glossary AGENTS.md: unlike s3-defs, it does not say that `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` and the managed CLAUDE.md do not count. A learner who reads only the glossary may think a personal CLAUDE.md blocks AGENTS.md. Consider appending 「`~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` は数えません。」

practice-setup: splitting `mkdir cc-practice-06 && cd cc-practice-06 && git init` into 3 lines drops the guard. If `cd` fails, `cat > CLAUDE.md` overwrites the CLAUDE.md of the current folder. To keep it narrow, consider the first line 「mkdir -p cc-practice-06 && cd cc-practice-06」, then 「git init」.
hook-b1 (unchanged, carried from the previous review): so the promise matches the single predict question, replace 「何を、どこに、どれだけ書けばよいのか、まず予想してみましょう。」 with 「まず、`.env` の読み取りをどう止めるか、予想してみましょう。」

check-quiz e6 option a (unchanged, carried from the previous review): 「IMPORTANT」 is still the wrong answer in five items (q0 a, q2 a, q5 a, e3 c, e6 a). Replace e6 a with md 「「前のセッションで頼んであるから、もう覚えているよ」」 and feedback 「セッションは毎回まっさらに始まり、前の会話は引き継がれません。止めたい操作は、拒否ルールやフックで決めておきます。」

practice-hint3 (unchanged, carried from the previous review): 「7・8行目はテストのコマンドの行にまとめます」 still does not match practice-answer, which keeps two test lines. Replace that clause with 「7行目は「コミットの前に `npm run test:unit` を通す」に直し、8行目は残します」.

practice-steps pr-permissions expect (unchanged, carried from the previous review): Claude may write `Bash(git push:*)` or `Read(.env)`. Replace it with 「拒否ルールとして、`.env` の読み取りと `git push` を止める2行が見つかります（例：`Read(./.env)`、`Bash(git push *)`）。」
Budget guard: prose is at 2400 of the 2,400 cap (measure.mjs). Offset any text the fixes add with an equal cut.
summary: This is a verification round (review-scope exit 0, 14% of parts changed). The previous review had no open must-fix items. The changed tables, glossary, AGENTS.md definition, practice code and next-lesson pointer are accurate and consistent, and the practice highlight was correctly shifted to lines 5–9. One regression blocks a pass: the narrowed s3-diagram draws CLAUDE.md → paths: なしのルール → コンテキスト as a chain, and its alt mentions auto memory that is no longer drawn. Merge the startup items into one node and align the alt as given.
